listing.name: Another Portrait Pack
listing.summary: Adds a collection of new portraits for various factions.

description:

-v1.4 (April 1, 2021)

Now affects the Mercenary faction added in 0.95a.

-v1.3 (March 29, 2021)

Updated for game version 0.95a.

Redid portrait assignments for each faction. Previous assignments gave factions portraits that they weren't supposed to have.

Changed hosting to GitHub. Should now work with Version Checker, when/if it updates.

Added missing functionality with the Scavengers faction.

Added three portraits.

Adjusted which factions use what portraits.

-v1.1.1 (Feb 16, 2019)

Fixed a portrait background.

Added Version Checker compatibility.

Fixed a certain portrait being categorized incorrectly.
